items.prompt: Which statement about direct access is true?
options: Faster seek time than sequential access
Writes start from the disk's start
Hard disks rarely use direct access
items.why: Direct access reaches data directly, generally giving faster seek time than sequential access.

items.prompt: Which system needs a network connection?
items.why: Distributed processing spans multiple computers, so it needs a network; real-time and batch processing can run locally.

items.prompt: What happens when 01100000 is added to 01100000?
items.why: Two copies of 96 exceed the 8-bit sign-and-magnitude range, so the addition overflows.

items.prompt: Which clause filters salary above 5000 and sorts ascending?
items.why: WHERE filters rows before sorting and ORDER BY sorts the results ascending.

items.prompt: Which should be considered when creating a presentation?
options: Layout, colour scheme and slide sequence
items.why: Layout, colour scheme and slide sequence should all be considered.

items.prompt: Which string does UPPER("technology") return?
items.why: UPPER converts every letter to uppercase, giving TECHNOLOGY.

items.prompt: Which is not required for a mail merge?
items.why: Mail merge needs a data source, a main document and merge fields, but no field length.

items.prompt: Which is a benefit of creating a report in PDF?
items.why: PDF preserves the text format of the report.

items.prompt: Which image formats support transparent backgrounds?
items.why: PNG and GIF support transparent backgrounds; JPG does not.

items.prompt: Which activity involves Object Linking and Embedding?
options: Inserting an image in a slide
items.why: OLE is used when inserting objects, such as images, into a slide.

items.prompt: Which statement about Unicode is correct?
options: Used for English and other languages
items.why: Unicode represents characters in English and other languages.

items.prompt: Which is faster — cache memory or RAM?
items.why: Cache memory is accessed faster than RAM.

items.prompt: What is the main function of a network interface card?
items.why: A network interface card sends and receives network signals.

items.prompt: Which is a function of an operating system?
items.why: An OS allocates hardware resources between programs.

items.prompt: Which is not a specification of a projector?
items.why: 5400 rpm measures hard disk speed, not a projector.

items.prompt: Why does a new USB printer work immediately?
options: The printer has a built-in CPU
The RAM size is large enough
The OS already has a driver
items.why: The operating system already has a driver program for the printer.

items.prompt: Which statement about HTTP is correct?
options: Fetches web pages from a server
Converts domain names to IP addresses
items.why: HTTP is used to retrieve web pages from a web server.

items.prompt: What does a third-party cookies notice mean?
options: Email address book may be disclosed
A virus is about to arrive
items.why: A third-party cookies notice means personal information may be collected.

items.prompt: Which protocol is used to upload a photo to a website?
items.why: HTTP transfers the photo to the browser and website.

items.prompt: Which statement about IP addresses is correct?
options: Works with the Internet and Intranet
items.why: IP addresses work on both the Internet and an Intranet.

items.prompt: What are the input and output of a DNS server?
items.why: A DNS server takes a domain name and returns an IP address.

items.prompt: What is a typical advantage of wired networks?
items.why: Wired networks offer a more stable connection.

items.prompt: Which is an advantage of modular design?
items.why: Modules can be reused in other scenarios.

items.prompt: What is an advantage of open source software?
options: Users can improve and share code
items.why: Open source users can improve the code and share it with the community.

items.prompt: Which are proper measures when using social media?
items.why: Proper measures include managing privacy settings, using a strong password and checking what you have provided.

items.prompt: Which programs can enhance computer security?
items.why: Firewalls and encryption programs enhance security; adware does not.

items.prompt: Which can help bridge the digital divide?
items.why: Free computers in libraries and Internet access for students in need help bridge the digital divide.

items.prompt: What is a benefit of SSL on websites?
items.why: SSL encrypts the data transferred over the website.

items.prompt: Why do companies prefer commercial software?
items.why: Commercial software developers can provide better support.

items.prompt: How does frequent OS updating protect against viruses?
items.why: Frequent updates fix security loopholes that viruses exploit.
